section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants of a study, consisting of 369 women from the general Portuguese population. Their mean age was 26.84 years, and their mean BMI was 23.21 kg/m2, which is consistent with normal weight values and the female Portuguese population's BMI distribution.
section_summary.evidence_source: Participants were 369 women from general population, aged between 18 and 55 years old (M = 26.84; SD = 8.74). Participants' Body Mass Index (BMI) presented a mean of 23.21 kg/m2 (SD = 4.90), which corresponds to normal weight values, according to the conventional classification (WHO, 1995). Furthermore, the sample's BMI distribution revealed to be equivalent to the female Portuguese population's BMI distribution (Poínhos et al., 2009).
